_note: Hand-written reference spec for REQ-020, used to test the checks and the dbt generator. Not agent output.
summary: Track each step of the new 3-step checkout so drop-off per step is visible, without changing checkout_conversion.

events.name: checkout_step_viewed
events.trigger: Each time a checkout step renders, including going back to a step.
events.description: A shopper saw a step of the 3-step checkout.

events.name: checkout_started
events.trigger: Unchanged: fires once when the shopper enters checkout, before step 1.
events.description: Kept as the denominator of checkout_conversion.

kpi_links.reason: Must keep checkout_started firing once per checkout, not once per step.

privacy_notes: No personal data; shipping address fields are not captured.
